jobs.title: Product Manager (SF)
jobs.description:
ABOUT HEX

Hex is growing our team of builders on a mission to make everyone a data person. Our platform solves key pain points with today’s data and analytics tooling, and empowers anyone to explore data using natural language, with or without code, on trusted context. Thousands of customers like Ramp https://hex.tech/customers/ramp/, Figma https://hex.tech/customers/figma/, Stubhub https://hex.tech/customers/stubhub/, Anthropic, and Gamma love Hex https://www.g2.com/products/hex-tech-hex/reviews for our beautiful UI, agentic superpowers, and boundless flexibility.

Hex has raised over $100M from leading investors like Sequoia, a16z, Snowflake and Amplify. With office hubs in San Francisco and New York, as well as remote team members throughout the US and UK, we’re a high-agency team that ships fast and has fun doing it. Check out our Intro to Hex video https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=qAXsnrNlavk and employee handbook https://www.notion.so/hexhq/Hex-Handbook-9fff0d42860e4f70815c599e0d1664d6 to learn more about what it’s like to work at Hex.




ABOUT THE ROLE

Hex is looking for a Product Manager to join the team and help drive the future of how teams work with data. Hex is a product-led company with a strong sales motion, so you’ll get to think deeply about product details and work with our sales team to make sure the product is successful in the market. We’re not big on titles, but this role might index to a Senior Product Manager at another company.

We’re looking for the next PM to move forward our analytical features: notebooks, dashboarding and our conversational AI interfaces. Our recent launches, specifically our AI features like Threads https://hex.tech/blog/introducing-threads/ and the Notebook Agent https://hex.tech/blog/introducing-notebook-agent/, have driven a huge amount of momentum for the company and our next PM will help us continue that momentum.




WHAT YOU WILL DO

 - Own an area of the product and be responsible for driving forward a coherent vision for that product that resonates with customers

 - Do early discovery and help define which problems are worth solving

 - Get deep with customers to understand their roles, what they are trying to accomplish and how to make them more impactful in their work

 - Do competitive research, get deep in the data and analytics space and understand our Market

 - Collaborate closely with engineering, design and GTM teams to deliver high-impact features

 - Learn from the sales process to see what’s resonating




ABOUT YOU

 - 5 years+ of hands-on experience as either a Product Manager, product-engaged Solutions / Sales Engineer, or customer-engaged Engineer

 - Experience with technical products, and demonstrated ability to dive deep into complex systems

 - We’re a growth-stage startup, so we’re looking for PMs that can ship quickly and iterate

 - Preference for candidates with experience or strong interest in data and analytics

 

This role will be hybrid (1-2 days per week in office) out of our San Francisco headquarters. 



The salary range for this role is: $177,000 - $300,000



In addition to our unique culture, Hex proudly offers a competitive total rewards package, including but not limited to, market-benched salary & equity, comprehensive health benefits, and flexible paid time off.

The salary range shown may be a reflection of additional factors such as geographical location and skill ranges/levels we’re open to. Placement in the salary range will be decided upon completion of the interview process, taking into account factors like leaving room for growth, internal fairness & parity, your demonstrated skills, and the depth of your experience. Our Recruiting team will be able to provide more details during the interview process.



By submitting an application the candidate consents to the use of their personal information in accordance with the Hex Privacy policy: https://learn.hex.tech/docs/trust/privacy-policy.

jobs.description:

Hex is growing our team of builders on a mission to make everyone a data person. Our platform solves key pain points with today’s data and analytics tooling, and empowers anyone to explore data using natural language, with or without code, on trusted context. Hex has raised over $100M from leading investors like Sequoia, a16z, Snowflake and Amplify. With office hubs in San Francisco and New York, as well as remote team members throughout the US and UK, we’re a high-agency team that ships fast and has fun doing it. Check out our Intro to Hex video https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=qAXsnrNlavk and employee handbook https://www.notion.so/hexhq/Hex-Handbook-9fff0d42860e4f70815c599e0d1664d6 to learn more about what it’s like to work at Hex.




ABOUT THE ROLE

Hex is looking for a Senior Product Manager, Monetization to join our Growth & Monetization group. Your role will require deeply understanding our users, buyers, internal systems, and market dynamics, to develop elegant pricing structures, billing systems, and user experiences that scale smoothly and drive growth. You’ll sit within a Product, Engineering and Design pod and collaborate closely with Sales, Marketing, and Data.

This is a full-time role based out of either of our New York, NY or San Francisco, CA offices.




WHAT YOU WILL DO:

 1. Build a clear and cohesive monetization journey: Ensure a clear and compelling user experience from evaluation to purchase and expansion. Own core product experiences as well as ancillary experiences like pricing calculators or guides for agents and humans.

 2. Monetize new products and features: Work with product managers and engineers to design pricing and packaging structures that fit how data leaders actually want to buy.

 3. Drive bigger monetization bets: Proactively identify and drive bigger company-wide monetization projects, such as credit model innovation for new products, or internationalization.

 4. Build billing systems and infrastructure to anticipate and remove scalability bottlenecks, enable faster pricing experimentation, and smooth rollout to customers.


ABOUT YOU:

 - Monetization expertise: You have 5+ years experience working on pricing, billing systems, monetization, or related AI products.

 - Execution: You scope to outcomes, ship quickly, and minimize time-to-learning. You excel in turning ambiguity into clarity that helps drive initiatives forward.

 - Communication & influence: You can build trust to get things done. You’re great at distilling complexity into clear comms, and getting cross-functional teams aligned.

 - Technical depth: You’ve been an engineer or product manager on an infrastructure or AI product, and understand how pricing intersects with product architecture and agentic workflows.

 - Customer obsessed: You talk with customers regularly to understand their needs. You care about business fundamentals but prioritize what’s right for customers.

Bonus points if you have:

 - Experience building and iterating on monetization models for application-layer AI products.

 - Background working on data tools, developer tools, or data analytics.

 

The salary range for this role is: $189,000 - $236,000.



In addition to our unique culture, Hex proudly offers a competitive total rewards package, including but not limited to, market-benched salary & equity, comprehensive health benefits, and flexible paid time off.

The salary range shown may be a reflection of additional factors such as geographical location and skill ranges/levels we’re open to.
